guides.title: Getting help: food, money & crisis support
guides.body:
If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911. For a mental-health, suicide or substance-use crisis, call or text 988 (24/7). Bergen County's 24/7 psychiatric emergency screening line is 201-262-4357 (201-262-HELP). For domestic violence, the Center for Hope & Safety hotline is 201-944-9600, any time. Poison Control: 1-800-222-1222.

Food
- Fair Lawn Food Pantry (Borough Human Services, Borough Hall Room 109, 8-01 Fair Lawn Ave): for Fair Lawn residents; call 201-794-5327 or email foodpantry@fairlawn.org and complete the Request Assistance form (English, Russian or Spanish) on fairlawn.org. Also gives grocery gift cards and Thanksgiving baskets.
- Church of St. Anne Food Pantry, 15-05 St. Anne St: 1st and 3rd Wednesdays; 201-791-1616.
- Center for Food Action, 224 Midland Ave, Saddle Brook: 201-703-9857.
- Jewish Family & Children's Services (kosher Corner Market pantry, Teaneck): 201-837-9090.
- SNAP (food stamps), cash aid and NJ FamilyCare: Bergen County Board of Social Services, 218 Route 17 N, Rochelle Park, 201-368-4200 (apply online at oneapp.dhs.state.nj.us).
- WIC for pregnant people, babies and kids under 5: St. Joseph's WIC, 973-754-4575.
- Seniors: Fair Lawn Senior Center lunch weekdays at noon (201-796-1191); Bergen County Meals on Wheels 201-336-7420; Kosher Meals on Wheels 201-796-5151.

Bills and housing
- The Borough's Human Services Trust can sometimes help with past-due utilities; its clerk also connects residents with mortgage help, discounted medical care and prescriptions, job training and other county/state programs (201-794-5327).
- NJ SHARES utility grants: 1-866-657-4273. Energy assistance (LIHEAP/USF): 1-800-510-3102; Bergen applications through Greater Bergen Community Action, 201-488-5100.
- Homeless prevention/shelter: Board of Social Services 201-368-4317. Anything else: dial 211.

Getting around
- Fair Lawn's free mini-bus runs weekdays within town for residents 18+ (book by 3 pm the business day before: 201-794-5327).
- Bergen County Community Transportation gives rides to medical appointments for seniors, people with disabilities and veterans: 201-368-5955 (book 2-3 weeks ahead).

Veterans and special needs
- Fair Lawn Veterans Affairs liaison: 201-794-5331, veterans@fairlawn.org. County Veterans Services: 201-336-6325.
- FLASE, the district's special-education parent group (SEPAG), supports families of students 3-21.

guides.title: Health care near Fair Lawn
guides.body:
Fair Lawn has no hospital of its own, but four emergency departments are within about 5 miles. In an emergency call 911 - the Fair Lawn Volunteer Ambulance Corps responds.

Hospitals (24/7 emergency)
- The Valley Hospital, 4 Valley Health Plaza, Paramus (GPS: 650 Winters Ave) - about 3 miles; 201-447-8000. Valley moved from Ridgewood in April 2024 and Ridgewood no longer has an ER.
- Bergen New Bridge Medical Center, 230 E Ridgewood Ave, Paramus - about 3 miles; also the county's psychiatric emergency screening site.
- St. Joseph's University Medical Center, 703 Main St, Paterson - about 3.4 miles; trauma center and children's hospital; 973-754-2000.
- Hackensack University Medical Center, 30 Prospect Ave, Hackensack - about 4.7 miles; trauma center and children's hospital; 551-996-2000.
- St. Joseph's Wayne Medical Center, 224 Hamburg Tpke, Wayne - about 4.7 miles.

Urgent care and pharmacies
- AM/PM Urgent Care with Englewood Health, 21-20 Broadway (Route 4): daily 8 am-midnight, walk-in; 551-444-6010.
- AFC Urgent Care Paramus, 67 E Ridgewood Ave: 201-262-2010. PM Pediatric Urgent Care (kids), Route 17 Paramus: 201-262-5437.
- 24-hour pharmacy: CVS, 24-12 Fair Lawn Ave (201-797-7500), with a MinuteClinic for shots and minor illness.

Public health and vaccines
- Fair Lawn contracts with the Northwest Bergen Regional Health Commission (201-445-7217) for nursing services: adult and childhood immunization clinics, child health conferences, blood-pressure screenings and communicable-disease follow-up.
- The 2026 borough flu clinic was Oct 5 at the Senior Center (pre-registration at fairlawn.org/flu2026; Medicare Part B accepted, otherwise $24.95/$68.95 cash). Bergen County has also offered free resident flu/COVID clinics in Hackensack - check bergencountynj.gov.

Low-cost and specialty care
- Paterson Community Health Center, 227 Broadway, Paterson (973-278-2600): medical, dental, OB/GYN and mental health with sliding-scale fees.
- Planned Parenthood, 575 Main St, Hackensack: 201-489-1140.
- Dental emergency: call your dentist's after-hours line first; uninsured patients can try Paterson Community Health Center. Go to an ER for facial swelling with fever, trouble swallowing or breathing, or a serious mouth injury.

Mental health
- 988 (call/text, 24/7); Bergen psychiatric emergency screening 201-262-4357 (24/7); NJ MentalHealthCares referral line 1-866-202-4357 (weekdays 8 am-8 pm, not a crisis line).
- Poison Control 1-800-222-1222 (text 973-339-0702).

guides.title: Houses of worship & the eruv
guides.body:
Fair Lawn is one of Bergen County's major Jewish communities, with seven Orthodox congregations inside the eruv, two Conservative synagogues, and a wide range of churches.

Orthodox synagogues (all maintain the Fair Lawn eruv)
- Congregation Shomrei Torah, 19-10 Morlot Ave - 201-791-7910
- Young Israel of Fair Lawn, 11-05 Saddle River Rd - 201-797-1800
- Congregation Ahavat Achim, 18-25 Saddle River Rd - 201-797-0502
- Congregation Darchei Noam, 10-04 Alexander Ave - 201-773-4080
- Congregation Bris Avrohom, 30-02 Fair Lawn Ave - 201-791-7200
- Sephardic Community of Fair Lawn, 40-34 Terhune Pl - 201-796-1525
- Anshei Lubavitch (Chabad), 10-10 Plaza Rd - 201-794-3770

Conservative synagogues
- Fair Lawn Jewish Center / Congregation B'nai Israel, 10-10 Norma Ave - 201-796-5040
- Temple Beth Sholom, 40-25 Fair Lawn Ave - 201-797-9321
- Nearby: Glen Rock Jewish Center, 682 Harristown Rd, Glen Rock - 201-652-6624. (Fair Lawn's Reform congregation, Temple Avoda, merged into Temple Avodat Shalom in River Edge.)

The Fair Lawn eruv
- Covers about 4 square miles, including parts of Glen Rock, Saddle Brook and Elmwood Park; it was expanded in 2018.
- It is inspected every Friday. Check status on fairlawneruv.com or the hotline 201-429-7066, and subscribe to the weekly eruv update email from the website. The map is at fairlawneruv.com/eruv-map.html.
- Other eruv questions: 201-757-8365 or info@fairlawneruv.com. Halachic questions: Rabbi Belizon (516-382-7596) or your rabbi.

Churches
- Roman Catholic: Church of St. Anne, 15-05 St. Anne St (201-791-1616) - also runs a food pantry.
- Armenian Apostolic: St. Leon Armenian Church, 12-61 Saddle River Rd (201-791-2862).
- Greek Orthodox: St. Athanasios, 51 Paramus Rd, Paramus (201-368-8881).
- Russian Orthodox: the nearest parish is the Church of Three Saints on Outwater Lane in Garfield.
- Protestant: Fair Lawn Community Church (Reformed, 10-10 Maxwell Pl; also a Taiwanese Reformed congregation), Warren Point Presbyterian (Broadway & 17th St), Our Savior Lutheran (22-15 Broadway), Episcopal Church of the Atonement (1-36 30th St), Van Riper-Ellis Broadway Baptist (7-01 River Rd), Fair Lawn Church of Christ (5-15 Plaza Rd), Grace Orthodox Presbyterian (S. Broadway), Bethel Evangelical Free (38 Albert Ave), Fair Lawn Bible Church (11-09 Hopper Ave), New Jersey First Methodist (27-06 High St).
- Korean-language: Peace Korean Reformed Church (39-23 Fair Lawn Ave) and Jesus Sarang Church (0-95 30th St).

Mosques
- No mosque is located in Fair Lawn itself; the Islamic Center of Passaic County, 152 Derrom Ave, Paterson, is about 2 miles away just across the Passaic River.

Service times change - call or check each congregation's website before visiting.

guides.title: Pets in Fair Lawn
guides.body:
Licensing
- New Jersey requires dogs and cats over 6 months old to be licensed. In Fair Lawn, licensing is handled by Human Services at Borough Hall (Room 109, 8-01 Fair Lawn Ave; 201-794-5327).
- Dog licenses run January 1-December 31; cat licenses run June 1-May 31. Renewals after the deadline cost an extra $10; newly acquired pets can register any time with no late fee.
- Fees: 1-year $12 (spayed/neutered) or $15 (not fixed); 3-year $30 or $40. Your pet's rabies vaccination must remain valid through the license period.
- Apply by mail with the form from fairlawn.org, proof of rabies vaccination, proof of spay/neuter if applicable, and a check payable to "Borough of Fair Lawn".

Free rabies clinics
- Fair Lawn holds free rabies clinics each May and November (usually the first week) in the garage next to the dog park and hockey field at Memorial Park, Essex St entrance off Morlot Ave. Cats must be in carriers.
- The Bergen County Animal Shelter also runs free clinics on alternating Wednesdays, 2-4 pm, by appointment (201-229-4600).

Animal control and lost pets
- For an animal attack, call 911. For other animal-control issues, call Fair Lawn Police non-emergency, 201-796-1400, and press 1.
- Fair Lawn contracts with the Bergen County Animal Shelter & Adoption Center, 100 United Lane, Teterboro (201-229-4600). Report lost pets there; county Animal Control is reachable 24/7 at 201-229-4616. Surrenders are by appointment (201-229-4601).
- Animal bites are investigated by the Northwest Bergen Regional Health Commission (201-445-7217).
- Dogs may not run at large anywhere in the borough.

Dog park
- The fenced Fair Lawn Dog Park is in Memorial Park behind the street-hockey courts, with separate areas for large dogs (over 30 lb) and small dogs. Open dawn to dusk; the borough can close it at any time.

Veterinarians
- In town: Valley Brook Veterinary Hospital, 3-21 Saddle River Rd (201-796-5833); Lincoln Avenue Cat & Dog Hospital, 133 Lincoln Ave (973-427-0990).
- 24/7 emergencies in Paramus: Oradell Animal Hospital, 580 Winters Ave (201-262-0010) and BluePearl Pet Hospital, 545 Route 17 (201-527-6699).

guides.title: Errands: post office, MVC, passports
guides.body:
Post offices in Fair Lawn
- Main post office, 14-24 Abbott Rd (Radburn): Mon-Fri 8:30 am-5 pm, Sat 8:30 am-1 pm; 201-796-0873. This is the only Fair Lawn branch that accepts passport applications.
- River Road branch, 12-44 River Rd: Mon-Fri 9 am-4:30 pm, closed weekends; 201-797-4267.
- Warren Point branch, 30-10 Broadway: Mon-Fri 9 am-4:30 pm, closed weekends; 201-796-5378.
- Nearby Saturday options include Glen Rock (73 Glen Ave) and Paramus (33 E Midland Ave).

Passports
- Fair Lawn main post office: by appointment Mon-Fri 9 am-3 pm and Sat 10 am-12:45 pm, with walk-in hours Tue-Thu 10-11 am; passport photos taken Mon-Fri 9 am-3 pm. Book at usps.com.
- Other post offices with passport service nearby: Paramus (33 E Midland Ave), Ridgewood (143 E Ridgewood Ave), Oradell.
- Bergen County Clerk passport counter, One Bergen County Plaza, Room 120, Hackensack: Mon-Fri 8:30 am-4 pm; 201-336-7011. No cash accepted for county fees since January 2026.
- Urgent travel? Congressman Gottheimer's district office in Fair Lawn (21-00 Route 208 S, Suite 240; 201-389-1100) can help with expedited passport cases.

Motor Vehicle Commission
- Lodi, 8 Mill St (off Garibaldi Ave): nearest full-service center for licenses, registrations, road tests and inspections.
- Wayne, 481 Route 46 West: licensing, road tests and inspections.
- Paramus, 20 W Century Rd: vehicle inspections only.
- Most in-person transactions need an appointment; many renewals and address changes can be done online at nj.gov/mvc.

Other errands
- Notary: The UPS Store, 12-45 River Rd (201-794-3935) and 6-05 Saddle River Rd; many banks notarize free for customers.
- Social Security: call 1-800-772-1213 or use ssa.gov; in-person offices are at 200 Federal Plaza, Paterson and 401 Hackensack Ave, Hackensack (weekdays 9 am-4 pm).
- Birth, death and marriage records for events in Fair Lawn: Registrar of Vital Statistics at Borough Hall ($10 per certified copy); marriage-license appointments by email to mkissane@fairlawn.org.

guides.title: Childcare, preschool & family support
guides.body:
Daycare and preschool in Fair Lawn
- Kiddie Academy, 16-00 Pollitt Dr - 201-773-1616 (infants to pre-K)
- Lightbridge Academy, 22-50 Maple Ave - 475-290-6344
- The Learning Experience, 15-22 Fair Lawn Ave - 888-290-6366
- Evergreen Academy, 4-24 Saddle River Rd - 551-250-0606 (18 months-6 years)
- Jewish programs: Anshei Lubavitch Daycare & Preschool (10-10 Plaza Rd, 201-794-3770), Kol Chaverim (8-12 Saddle River Rd, 201-509-8433), Alef Preschool at Temple Beth Sholom (201-793-4800), Gan Iris Nursery School (11-16 Plaza Rd, 201-414-6998), Leah Sokoloff/Shalom Yeladim (201-778-6000), Fair Lawn Jewish Center Nursery School (201-796-5040).

Before- and after-school care
- Fair Lawn Community School runs before-care (7:15-8:35 am) and after-care (to 6 pm) for public-school students in K-8. Registration opens in May; 201-794-5450 ext. 2369, flcs@fairlawnschools.org.

Special needs
- FLASE (Fair Lawn Association for Special Education) is the district's special-education parent advisory group (SEPAG) for students 3-21.

Help for families
- WIC (St. Joseph's): 973-754-4575. SNAP and NJ FamilyCare: Bergen County Board of Social Services, 201-368-4200. Back-to-school supplies and holiday gifts: Fair Lawn Human Services, 201-794-5327.
